english.title: Fail to remove a building made of short lived materials when ordered by a local authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..), failed to remove the building by **(..SPECIFY DATE..), being the date fixed under section 19 of the Building Act 1984 by which the building was required to have been removed
